Looking for a cheap management tool for a half-dozen accounts
My head is spinning trying to choose a social media management tool to manage a half-dozen accounts (for a single company) that is not a Hootsuite-level price (ideally $20-$30/month tops). The options seem almost endless and my research is just bringing up more and more options, so before I'm forced to randomly select a few free trials for testing I though I'd ask you good folks is you have a preference. 

I just need something that pulls all the accounts together for posting a few times a week (with only minimal scheduling required), easy engagement with all accounts in one place, and basic analytics. So nothing terribly fancy. So far my list includes Buffer, Zoho, HighLevel, Socialrail, Sendible, Socialbee, Metricool, and Content Studio. TBH it looks like a list of randomly generated words mashed together :D

I'm leaning towards Buffer simply because I've used it before. I've also used Hootsuite and Sprout in the past for larger accounts, but even if they were suddenly free they'd be such ridiculous overkill for my current requirements that I'd probably avoid them.
